## Summary

Describe the problem, the scoped change, and any known limitations.

## Validation

List the commands you ran and their observed results.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change has a clear, focused scope.
- [ ] Agent Skills specification requirements are preserved where applicable.
- [ ] Tests were added or adjusted when behavior changed.
- [ ] Automated tests and structural validation were run successfully.
- [ ] Generated distribution checks were run when canonical skills or package metadata changed; documentation-only changes did not regenerate package content.
- [ ] Documentation was updated when applicable.
- [ ] Compatibility, installation, and behavioral claims match the evidence actually collected.
- [ ] Versioning impact and any generated-artifact changes are identified.
- [ ] The pull request contains no unrelated changes.
